test a weighted combination with inverse_error weights to see if giving more weight to low‑error models improves over the mean baseline, given the unstable ranking hint.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust DBA (dynamic bagging) may adapt better than static mean/weights.
test a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a probabilistic weighting improves over inverse_error, given the unstable rankings.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust median over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers.
try a per‑horizon weighted strategy using the top‑k mean handle (w4) to capture possible horizon‑specific improvements.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a robust trimmed mean might reduce influence of outlier models while keeping more diversity.
softmax weights on the stable subset
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a robust dynamic bagging on a stable subset may adapt better than static weighted means.
test a per‑horizon weighted combo on the full pool to see if horizon‑varying strengths help in this trend‑dominated series.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w8' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9775. Series context: trend strength 0.7624 and seasonal strength 0.1505; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.06); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.251.
